extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Meaning of work — Work is done when a force moves an object through a distance. Work = force x distance. Work IS done: lifting a bag, pulling a cart, throwing a ball. Work is NOT done: pushing a wall that doesn't move (no displacement), holding a weight still (no displacement), carrying a bag horizontally at constant height (force is upward but motion is horizontal, no work in direction of force). (2) Energy is needed for work — Energy is the ability to do work. Without energy, no work can be done. We get energy from food (for humans and animals) and from fuel/electricity (for machines). (3) Forms of energy — Light energy (sun, bulb), Heat energy (fire, heater), Electrical energy (battery, wires), Sound energy (speaker, drum), Kinetic energy (moving objects), Potential energy (stored, like a stretched spring or water behind a dam), Solar energy (from sun), Chemical energy (in food, fuel, batteries). (4) Renewable and non-renewable sources — Renewable: can be used again and again, will not run out. Solar, wind, hydro, biomass, geothermal, tidal. Non-renewable: limited supply, will run out, take millions of years to form. Coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear. Fossil fuels (coal, petroleum, natural gas) cause pollution. Misconceptions: 'pushing a wall is work' (WRONG — work requires displacement; if the wall doesn't move, no work is done even though you feel tired), 'carrying a bag horizontally is work against gravity' (WRONG — the force is upward but motion is horizontal; no work is done against gravity when moving at constant height), 'energy and work are the same' (WRONG — energy is the ABILITY to do work; work is what happens when energy is used), 'solar energy will run out' (WRONG — solar energy is renewable; the sun will shine for billions of years), 'coal is renewable because we still have it' (WRONG — coal is non-renewable because it takes millions of years to form; once used it cannot be replaced in human timescales).
